_readme: r339 T-02b — off-book cap review register (the documented escape hatch). A section whose off-book share (excused elements ×12 + suppressed checks, over measured + off-book estimate) reaches >=70% fails the gate FAIL(off-book) UNLESS it has an entry in reviews[] here. Requirements, enforced by run.mjs at startup (fail-closed): section must be a known mapping key; reason must be a WRITTEN explanation (>=20 chars) of why the off-book mass is legitimate and what measures it; owner must be a task id (T-…). A review suppresses the FAIL(off-book) label only — the 40% coverage floor has no escape (lift it with section work, not paperwork) and the 50% heuristic-share cap is unaffected. Entries are listed in results.summary.coverage.reviewedEscapes on every run that invokes them: documented, never silent.

reviews.reason: The footer's off-book mass is the frozen reference's own DOM topology, not unmapped Madarek work: the census records deep wrapper chains (4-div nests inside every link seat), staged-duplicate window captures (re-anchored boxes sharing paths), svg defs/filter internals of the grayscale tonal twin, and 0x0 tween-residue boxes — ~1372 excused element-instances across 5 bps vs 85 data-spec bindings + 6086 measured checks. Every excused path carries a written reason in mapping/footer.json (280 collision/plumbing rows, generated by scripts/build-footer-mapping.py's path-equality model). The honest lift is mirroring the reference's wrapper-chain nesting in Footer.tsx (the R342-07 method, 19.4%→25.2% this round) — a dedicated section task, tracked as the R342-11 report's remaining blocker; the coverage floor (25.2% < 40%) is NOT suppressed by this review and stays a FAIL.

The intro's off-book mass is the reference's text-roll tween plumbing: the census records the h2's per-word/per-char split boxes (96-127 div.short per bp), parked roll copies, loop duplicates and 0x0 tween boxes — 2130 excused element-instances across 5 bps vs 326 explicit bindings (intro.line/word/wordin/wchar.N.M mirrors, 254 with tag+geometry skips) + 9551 measured checks at 98-100% cell rates. Every residue path carries a written reason in mapping/home-intro-wrap.json. The honest lift is deepening the split-text mirror in Statement.tsx to bind the remaining word-wrapper windows — a dedicated section task, tracked as the R342-11 report's remaining blocker; the coverage floor (24.8% < 40%) is NOT suppressed by this review and stays a FAIL.

R347 D4: the drafting-noise chrome (rulers, +/- marks, graticule, deco cards, edge frame, the ~95-div grid + vector-chrome layers) is retired with its elements per the owner's directive - ONE calm artwork; 198 binding entries deleted with them, so the heron-side off-book mass (the grid/chrome census) now dominates the section's estimate. The retirement is measured and documented in docs/redesign/r347/DEFECTS-A.md; the visible defect fix outranks the coverage metric (R346 §0/§3).
